**Main line:** R4d6+ Kh5 Rxh7#

**Motif:** fork (the rook on d6 checks the king and attacks the h7 pawn simultaneously, forcing the king away so it can be captured with mate)

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent's king is driven to the edge of the board, look for forcing moves that attack two targets at once. Here, R4d6+ puts the king in check while the rook also eyes the h7 pawn. Black must move to h5, and then Rxh7# is mate because the rook controls all escape squares. Recognize when a quiet pawn move (like g5) loosens the king's shelter—that's your signal to attack!
